text:
Alex G: Kicking off eu-north kubeadm cluster bring-up (air-gapped). 8 A100 nodes per rack, local registry at 10.0.0.5:5000, containerd runtime, Calico MTU 1400. Need a short validation checklist + handoff for oncall tomorrow morning.
Priya R: Nice — add these high-priority checks: node join sanity, GPU driver + nvidia-container-toolkit, registry sync, DNS resolution for pods, and control-plane cert rotation check. Keep it short. :thumbsup:
Ken (oncall): Also confirm kube-proxy mode (IPVS), conntrack settings, and kubelet eviction thresholds. If any kube-proxy iptables remnants exist we get flappy services.
Alex G: Agree. Drafting quick commands below for the runbook so oncall can run them without internet:

1) Verify control plane and pods:
```
kubectl get nodes -o wide
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
kubectl describe pod coredns-xxx -n kube-system
```
2) GPU driver + runtime:
```
ssh node-01 "nvidia-smi"
ssh node-01 "containerd --version"
kubectl -n kube-system get ds gpu-operator -o wide || echo "gpu-operator missing"
```
3) Local registry smoke test (from a node):
```
curl -fsS http://10.0.0.5:5000/v2/_catalog || echo "registry unreachable"
ctr images pull 10.0.0.5:5000/redwood/sample:smoke
ctr images ls | grep sample
```
4) Network: MTU + conntrack + CNI plugin:
```
ip link show | grep mtu
sysctl net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max
kubectl get pods -n kube-system -o wide | grep calico
```
5) kubeadm join token sanity (control plane created with static-config):
```
kubeadm token list
kubeadm certs check-expiration
```

Priya R: For the cluster config, use a minimal kubeadm config snippet for air-gapped installs (we baked it into repo). Make sure --image-repository points to 10.0.0.5:5000 and pause/image mirrors are present. Also pin kube-proxy to IPVS and enable conntrack helpers.

Ken (oncall): A few gotchas I want called out in the thread for the handoff:
- Node auto-repair disabled (we don't want unexpected reboots during benchmarking)
- Node taints: gpu=true:NoSchedule applied to GPU pool + tolerations on kube-system addons
- Kubelet --fail-swap-on false in this environment (swap present for host diagnostics)
- Make sure file-backed hugepages not enabled unless explicitly needed

infra-bot: [preflight] registry-sync: OK; certs: expiring in 83 days; calico-typha: Running.

Luis SRE: Quick note on capacity/cost: we intentionally overprovision one rack as hot spare (12.5% overhead) for scheduled model load tests — document expected sustained usage and peak burst in the ticket so finance can map to Dedicated reserve vs pay-as-you-go.

Alex G: Hand-off checklist (for oncall):
- [ ] Run control-plane and kube-system pod checks
- [ ] Run gpu driver + nvidia-smi on each GPU node
- [ ] Pull sample image from local registry
- [ ] Verify Calico pods + MTU match docs (1400)
- [ ] Confirm kube-proxy IPVS mode and conntrack settings
- [ ] Verify taints/tolerations on GPU pool
- [ ] Run small inference smoke test (1 replica) and monitor latency
- [ ] Post results to this thread and update ticket #INFRA-4822

Priya R: For the smoke inference test, use the prebuilt image we pushed to the registry: 10.0.0.5:5000/redwood/inference-smoke:2026-03-17 — it runs a minimal TensorRT-backed model and prints latency percentiles.

Ken (oncall): I'll be on standby 06:00–10:00 CET. If anything fails, escalate to @Priya R and @Luis SRE. Use pager policy redwood/oncall -> infra escalation.

Alex G: Thanks team — I'll update the runbook with these commands and the handoff checklist, then mark this thread when ready. :rocket:

Luis SRE: After handoff, please snapshot the cluster kubeadm config and the local registry manifest into the ticket. We need reproducibility for the next region turnup.

Alex G: Done — runbook PR opened and linked in INFRA-4822. Handoff ready.

Ken (oncall): Received and ACKed.
